procedure: Access Brother Web-Based Management at http://[printer-ip]
Navigate to Administrator tab > Import/Export Settings
Click 'Choose File' or 'Browse' under Import section
Select previously saved configuration file (.csv or .txt)
Printer automatically reboots to apply settings
Print Configuration Page to confirm all settings restored

causes: Toner cartridge near end of life
solutions: Check toner level on LCD display
Order replacement Brother TN-43x toner
Continue printing with 'Toner Low' warning
When 'Replace Toner' appears, replace cartridge
After replacing: Open and close front cover to reset
Use genuine Brother toner for best quality
Consider high-yield TN-439 series for lower cost per page

commonErrors.description: Drum unit near end of life
causes: Drum approaching or at 30,000 page life
Drum counter needs reset after replacement
solutions: Order replacement DR-431BK (black) or DR-431CL (color)
Continue using until print quality degrades
Replace drum when quality issues appear
After installing new drum, reset counter:
Hold down 'GO' button for 4 seconds
Select drum to reset (Black or Color)
Press '1' to confirm reset

commonErrors.description: Transfer belt near end of life
solutions: Order replacement BU-330CL belt unit
Continue using until prompted to replace
Replace belt when print quality degrades
Installation procedure:
Open front cover and remove drum units
Remove old belt unit
Install new BU-330CL belt
Reinstall drums and close cover
Belt counter resets automatically
Note the specific error code number
Turn printer off and wait 10 seconds
Turn printer back on
If error code 84 (fuser): Wait 30 min to cool
If error persists, contact Brother support
Common error 76: Memory issue - reduce print job complexity
Service may be required for persistent errors
